text:
Lisa (Partnerships): Quick sync — SecureBlocks (HSM vendor) wants to onboard a managed KMS connector + secrets-sync to our marketplace. Need a short playthrough for the integration and a comms plan. Who can pair on the tech checklist this week? :wave:
Kevin (DevRel): I can do the demo script and marketplace packaging. Need the connector spec from infra.
Raj (Security Eng): I'll own the HSM attestation and PKCS#11/PKCS12 compatibility checks. Can we get device certs from SecureBlocks?
Sophie (Product): Also need to decide whether we position this as "Redwood-managed KMS" or "partner-managed KMS" in the listing. That affects support SLA copy.
Lisa (Partnerships): Good point — let's default to partner-managed with optional managed onboarding. Marketing prefers co-branded listing for launch.
Marta (Legal): I'll review the data flow and export controls. Send me the high-level architecture and whether keys ever leave the HSM.
Kevin (DevRel): Tech checklist I'm thinking: 1) connector auth (OAuth2/JWKS) 2) key wrapping APIs (kms.encrypt/kms.decrypt) 3) HSM attestation + firmware check 4) secrets-sync plug (Vault/Secrets Manager) 5) metrics/logging hooks 6) e2e demo.
Raj (Security Eng): Add: tamper evidence, FIPS compliance claim check, KMS rotation policy, and a test for degraded path (HSM offline -> fallback to soft KMS with clear opt-in).
Lisa (Partnerships): Timeline proposal: week 0 (this week) tech deep-dive + cert exchange; week 1 dev/test connectors; week 2 e2e canary with a beta customer; week 3 marketplace listing + joint blog. Thoughts?
Sophie (Product): Sounds reasonable. Suggest we slip in an internal rollback playbook for customers who need immediate deactivation. Also add SCIM mapping for partner admin user sync.
Kevin (DevRel): I'll draft the demo script. Example CLI snippet for the connector auth flow we can include in docs:

```
# exchange oauth code for token
curl -X POST https://api.secureblocks.example.com/oauth/token \n  -d "grant_type=authorization_code&code=<CODE>&client_id=<ID>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded"
```

And a sample KMS call:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -d '{"plaintext":"hello"}' https://redwood.example.com/v1/kms/encrypt
```
Raj (Security Eng): For attestation, ask SecureBlocks for an ATE (attestation evidence). We'll verify firmware hash and manufacturer signature. If they can't provide, we require additional mitigations.
Marta (Legal): Also confirm liability for key compromise in the contract. Partner-managed implies they hold more responsibility — flagging for the MSA.
ops-bot: Reminder: please add a rollout label in the ticket tracker: partners/kms-onboard/secureblocks.
Lisa (Partnerships): Kevin/Raj — can you sync Tuesday 10am PT for the deep dive? I'll invite SecureBlocks and the SI contact (they'll help with secrets-sync).
Kevin (DevRel): Yep, added to my calendar. I'll draft the marketplace metadata template before the call.
Raj (Security Eng): I'll prepare an attestation checklist and a small test harness for HSM failure modes.
Sophie (Product): I'll mock up the listing copy (partner-managed variant) and support matrix.
Marta (Legal): Please share the architecture diagram and data residency notes ahead of the call.
Lisa (Partnerships): Action items: Kevin = demo + docs; Raj = attestation + failure-mode tests; Sophie = listing + rollback copy; Marta = contract flags; me = coordinate partner and SI. We'll aim for beta in two weeks. :rocket:
infra-bot: New ticket created: partners/kms-onboard/secureblocks (#2437) by Lisa.
Kevin (DevRel): Quick Q — do we want to include a sample SCIM mapping in the marketplace docs or keep SCIM as an integration appendix? I vote appendix.
Sophie (Product): Appendix sounds right. Keep the listing focused on value props and high-level security assurances.
Raj (Security Eng): One more: log redaction policy for secrets-sync. We need to ensure no key material ends up in logs or analytics.
Lisa (Partnerships): Noted. I'll consolidate and post a short playbook after the call. If anyone needs to add items before Tuesday, drop them here. :thumbsup:
